shared_tail.surface: عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير

notes: both branches write «خالد» and the names after the last «ح» (بيان ... الزبير) are shared; «- المعنى -» and «- قال مسدد أبو بشر -» are glosses
«أبيه» is Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, a bare relation; «قلت للزبير» : the one asked answers, so the Zubayr is the last link (rule 5); the preposition «ل» is not part of the surface
